result.description:
IKAD Engineering is a locally owned engineering firm specializing in the marine, mining, mineral processing and oil & gas industries. We are looking for a couple of experienced Boilermaker/Welders to join our team on a permanent full time basis.

The Role

This role requires a commitment to working as part of a team, adaptablity to a changing environment, the ability to work effectively with minimal supervision and flexibility to work potential overtime hours when required. General duties for this role include but are not limited to:

    Reading and interpreting drawings or taking verbal instructions to mark out, cut, weld and assemble steel;
    Perform welding in accordance with approved weld procedures and codes;
    Interpret welding symbols to ensure correct welding techniques;
    Carry out basic maintenance of welding machine and equipment to keep a clean and safe work area; and
    Follow all workshop and site safety requirements.

The successful candidates must have previous workshop experience and be able to demonstrate the following essential personal attributes and skills:

    Sound knowledge all aspects of fabrication, including structural, plate work & piping with carbon steel & exotic materials.
    FCAW/GTAW welding experience.
    Cert III Heavy Fabrication.
    2+ years’ post trade experience.
    Physically fit & enthusiastic.
    Ensuring all activities are completed in a safe and efficient manner.
    Identify and report potential safety hazards and take appropriate actions.
    A strong problem solving ability.

Benefits

    Secure permanent full-time position.
    Day shift 6.30am – 3pm with potential overtime.
    Great annual salary of $80,000-$90,000. 
    Located in Rozelle, NSW (no FIFO).
    Well known international, family & locally owned engineering company.

An all-inclusive workplace supportive and welcoming of diverse backgrounds.
